A grounding verdict is the result of the platform's grounding validator checking a model's claims. The engine owns every number, and language models only explain engine figures and cite Report passages. The validator checks that each claim is supported by an engine figure or a Report passage. A claim that fails the check is shown to the user marked "ungrounded".

No LLM Exchange is selected on this screen, so I can't tell you the verdict for any specific Exchange. Open one and ask again to get details about it.
